items.informal_name: Numerical Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that takes a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and another natural number $m$, returning a natural number used to establish well-founded recursion in the context of multivariate polynomials and Chevalley's theorem. It computes bounds by recursively applying $f$ to $n$ and decrementing $m$.

items.informal_name: Lower Bound for Polynomial Evaluation at Rational Points
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|
items.informal_description: For any linearly ordered field $ K $ with strict ordered ring structure, given a non-zero polynomial $ f \in \mathbb{Z}[X] $, integers $ a, b $ with $ b > 0 $, and assuming $ f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \neq 0 $, it holds that $ 1 \leq b^{\deg(f)} \cdot \left| f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \right| $, where $ \deg(f) $ denotes the natural degree of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Approximation of Polynomials over Finite Fields via Modulo Operations
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] {b : Polynomial Fq},
  b ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ (A : Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-Real.log ε / Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊).succ → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any non-zero polynomial $ b $ over a finite field $ \mathbb{F}_q $ and any $ \varepsilon > 0 $, if $ A $ is a family of polynomials indexed by a finite set of size $ q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log q \rceil} $, then there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 $ such that the $ \mathbb{F}_q $-cardinality-degree norm of $ (A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) $ is less than $ \varepsilon \cdot q^{\deg b} $. Here, the cardinality-degree norm $ \text{cardPowDegree}(p) $ of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as $ q^{\deg p} $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Polynomial Pairs with Bounded Degree Difference
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Ring Fq] {d m : ℕ},
  Fintype.card Fq ^ d ≤ m →
    ∀ (b : Polynomial Fq) (A : Fin m.succ → Polynomial Fq),
      (∀ (i : Fin m.succ), (A i).degree < b.degree) → ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ (A i₁ - A i₀).degree < ↑(b.natDegree - d)
items.informal_description: Given a finite ring $ Fq $ with cardinality $ q $, natural numbers $ d $ and $ m $ such that $ q^d \leq m $, a nonzero polynomial $ b \in Fq[X] $, and a function $ A: \mathrm{Fin}(m+1) \to Fq[X] $ where each $ A(i) $ has degree less than $ \deg(b) $, there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 \in \mathrm{Fin}(m+1) $ such that the degree of $ A(i_1) - A(i_0) $ satisfies $ \deg(A(i_1) - A(i_0)) < \mathrm{natdeg}(b) - d $, where $ \mathrm{natdeg}(b) $ denotes the natural degree of $ b $ (equal to $ \deg(b) $ if nonzero, otherwise 0).

items.informal_name: Power Inequality for Descending Pochhammer Symbol in Ordered Semirings
items.type:
∀ {S : Type u_1} [inst : Ring S] [inst_1 : PartialOrder S] [IsStrictOrderedRing S] {n : ℕ} {s : S},
  ↑n - 1 ≤ s → (s - ↑n + 1) ^ n ≤ Polynomial.eval s (descPochhammer S n)
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and element $s$ in a strict ordered semiring $S$, if $n - 1 \leq s$, then $(s - n + 1)^n \leq \text{descPochhammer}(S, n)(s)$, where $\text{descPochhammer}(S, n)(s)$ denotes the descending Pochhammer polynomial evaluated at $s$.
